tools.name: readability
tools.description:
Fetches webpages and extracts clean, readable content using Mozilla Readability.
Automatically strips away non-essential HTML elements like ads, navigation menus,
footers, sidebars, and other clutter to deliver the core article content.

This tool is preferred over standard web fetch operations because it returns
focused, human-readable text rather than raw HTML, significantly reducing noise
and improving content quality for analysis and summarization tasks.

urls.description: The URLs of the webpages to parse and extract text from.
